name: 5 mm LED (through-hole)
blurb: Plain 5 mm indicator light; always needs a series resistor and only works one way round.

pins.name: A
pins.note: Anode: the longer leg, on the round side of the base. Goes toward the positive side, through a resistor.

pins.name: K
pins.note: Cathode: the shorter leg, next to the flat edge on the base. Goes toward GND.

verify: Standard T-1 3/4 outline: 5 mm lens, 5.8 mm flange, about 8.6 mm total height, 2.54 mm lead pitch. Not read from a manufacturer drawing. Measure your LEDs: lens height varies (flat-top and oval types are shorter). Forward voltage and the 20 mA ceiling depend on colour (about 2 V red/yellow/green, 3 V blue/white); check the seller's listing before choosing the resistor. Drawing-only fields on the pins: z -1 puts each leg at the underside of the 1 mm flange; lead 17 mm is a typical trimmed leg length, not read from a drawing.
sources: Standard 5 mm (T-1 3/4) LED package dimensions; no manufacturer drawing opened
